anomalies.observed: On the SkylabModule sheet, the gate pull-up resistor R2 on the Q2 (NTR2101P) gate node is drawn with value '10M' (10 MΩ), tied between +3V3 and Q2 pin 1 (gate).
anomalies.expected: The specification states R2 is a 10 kΩ gate pull-up that keeps Q2's gate high (off) by default; a 10 kΩ value is required here, not 10 MΩ (three orders of magnitude too large).

evidence.quote: SkylabModule.kicad_sch: R2, value '10M', connected between +3V3 and Q2.1 (gate)
the gate pull-up R2 (10 kΩ, pulling Q2's gate high/off by default)

anomalies.impact: A 10 MΩ pull-up is far too weak to hold the P-channel MOSFET gate at source potential against leakage and noise. Q2 (the EPD high-side power switch) may not stay reliably off, can partially turn on, and the gate node becomes noise-sensitive — degrading the Display_Power_Switch rail control and aggravating the documented 'heats up while off' behaviour.
